subject: Your 45-day milestone unlocked a new level
preview_text: You're not a new user anymore. Here's what comes next with Smart Notes.
body_paragraphs: 45 days ago, you took a leap. You downloaded Smart Notes because you were tired of losing key points after meetings and wasting hours rewriting notes. That version of you is gone now. You've built a habit of clarity.

Here's the thing: most users stop at basic transcribing. But the ones who stick around discover a game-changer—using language controls to capture meetings in Spanish, Mandarin, or French, and sharing structured summaries with their team in seconds. That's where the real time savings multiply.

You've already earned the badge of a power user. Now, it's time to unlock the next chapter: premium features like unlimited transcriptions and advanced search across all your notes. Think of it as your command center for every call, lecture, or brainstorm.

Open Smart Notes today and try the language-aware transcription on your next meeting. Feel the difference. P.S. Power users who set their default language save 30 minutes per week—check your profile settings now.
This isn't goodbye. It's a handshake. You're in the inner circle now.
